ARTICLE 12 - GENERAL PROVISIONS A. The clauses listed in the incorporated GENERAL PROVISIONS shall be applicable to this Subcontract based on the value of the Subcontract, the status of the Subcontractor, and the nature and location of the work, as indicated in the GENERAL PROVISIONS. B. This Subcontract shall not involve access to classified information and/or special nuclear material, or unescorted access to Limited security areas. CA Lic. #739160 DIR # 1000000303 PROJECT: Portable Tank Storage Pad RHWM - LLNL SCOPE: 4,860 sq. ft. (4,200 sq. ft. w/ 660 sq. ft. of walls) SYSTEM: Chemproof Polymers, Perma-Tec 4000 WORK TO BE PERFORMED AS FOLLOWS: 1) Demo existing coating system. 2) Vacuum recovery shot-blast concrete & diamond grind walls, rout cracks/joints. 3) Backer rod & mark joints & fill cracks with Perma-Flex 1000 Red. 4) Patch bugholes & spalls in walls and apply Perma-Coat 3000 Yellow primer. 5) Apply Perma-Coat 4000V Gray basecoat to walls. 6) Sand & patch walls, Apply Perma-Coat 3000 Red to pad floor. 7) Apply Perma-Coat 4000V Gray grout coat to walls. 8) Trowel 1/8” Perma-Tec 4000 Yellow slurry to pad floor and broadcast 3.0 flintshot aggregate. 9) Apply Perma-Coat 4000 Gray topcoat to walls 10) Sweep excess and trowel 1/8” Perma-Tec 4000 Gray slurry and broadcast 3.0 flintshot. 11) Sweep excess, detail, and apply Perma-Coat 4000 Gray topcoat to pad floor. 12) Cut & caulk joints with Poly-Spec Thiokol 2235 polysulfide. INCLUSIONS: Manufactures certified installer. Concrete
